## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND and Stocks vs Bonds signal neutral (SPY/TLT mixed with SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -1.68%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +3.37%)) confirm a mixed, neutral read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Energy surge: BNO (1W: +13.86% | 1M: +17.18%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND driving flows. Volatility rising: VXX (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND; credit signals mixed with HYG (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -0.26%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.99%) CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION shows month-long bond bid while SPY (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND shows equities soft; dollar per data flat (U.S. dollar signals neutral), leaving overall conditions balanced.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +10.71%). Tech weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -4.43%); Real Estate and Utilities showing month strength but short-week pullbacks (XLRE CORRECTION (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +5.48%), XLU CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +8.83%)). Style: mixed, cyclical tilt via energy.

5. US vs Global?  
US less weak than EM: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -1.68%) versus EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.71% | 1M: -1.15%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -8.96%), signaling EM weakness driving relative US resilience.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed speculative bid: IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +5.94% | 1M: -18.51%) and ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -3.49%) show short-term rebounds while small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -0.16%) remain soft.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Oil-led rally: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.69% | 1M: +13.43%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.86% | 1M: +17.18%) driving commodity strength; copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -2.28%) signals uneven industrial demand.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy clear leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +10.71%). Natural gas volatile: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +7.16% | 1M: -27.34%)—big short-term bounce inside a longer down move.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE) ABOVE TREND across timeframes. DIVERGENCE: multiple sector ETFs in CORRECTION (XLU, XLI, GLD, XLP) and EM (EEM, FXI) BELOW TREND—mixed internals warrant restraint.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to energy/commodity-linked ETFs (XLE, BNO) and monitor volatility (VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +10.84%)). Reduce exposure to China/EM (FXI, EEM) and tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -4.43%)) until breadth improves.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND, Energy/Comm. names showing strength. BEARISH: FXI (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -4.43%) BELOW TREND for downside risk.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +13.86% | 1M: +17.18%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +11.69% | 1M: +13.43%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -2.28%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: +7.16% | 1M: -27.34%) RECOVERY — watch for mean reversion.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (vol complacency/concern threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY near short-term support zone given 1M weakness, XLK/XLF relative ratio pivot to watch for style rotation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from volatility and credit keep the market balanced. Energy and oil ETFs (XLE, BNO) showing relative strength while EM (FXI, EEM) and Tech (XLK) divergences are key risks to monitor.
